name: pulse-card
description: Compact horizontal bar chart card for Home Assistant sensor data visualization
author: hiall-fyi

scripts.build: npm run build:pulse-card && npm run build:pulse-switch && npm run build:pulse-weather
scripts.build:pulse-card: esbuild src/pulse-bar/pulse-bar-card.js --bundle --outfile=dist/pulse-card.js --format=esm --minify --external:./pulse-bar-card-editor.js --external:./pulse-climate-editor.js --external:./pulse-weather-card-editor.js && node -e "const f='dist/pulse-card.js';require('fs').writeFileSync(f,require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace('./pulse-bar-card-editor.js','./pulse-card-editor.js'))" && esbuild src/pulse-bar/pulse-bar-card-editor.js --bundle --outfile=dist/pulse-card-editor.js --format=esm --minify && esbuild src/pulse-climate/pulse-climate-editor.js --bundle --outfile=dist/pulse-climate-editor.js --format=esm --minify && esbuild src/pulse-weather/pulse-weather-card-editor.js --bundle --outfile=dist/pulse-weather-card-editor.js --format=esm --minify
